about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Jamaican Escovitch Pickled Vegetable Sauce
recipes.summary: Hot, tangy pickled carrot, onion and chilli to spoon over fried fish or chicken.
steps: Heat the oil in a pan and fry the carrot, onion, capsicum and chilli for 3 minutes, until just starting to soften but still crisp.
Add the vinegar, allspice, sugar and salt and simmer for 5 minutes, until the vegetables are tender but bright.
Cool to room temperature, then spoon over hot fried fish or chicken.
notes: Keeps in a clean jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Trinidadian Corn Soup
recipes.summary: Sweet corn soup with split peas, pumpkin and small dumplings, sold by street vendors at night.

items: 4 corn cobs, kernels cut off and cobs halved

steps: Simmer the split peas and corn cobs in the water with the onion and garlic for 25 minutes, until the peas are soft.
Add the pumpkin, carrot and whole chilli and simmer 12 minutes, until tender.
Rub the butter into the flour with a pinch of salt, add water to a stiff dough and roll into small dumplings.
Add the dumplings and corn kernels and simmer for 10 minutes, until the dumplings float and are cooked through.
Remove the cobs and chilli, stir through the coriander, then season and serve.
notes: Remove the corn cobs before serving.

recipes.title: Haitian Soup Joumou Pumpkin Soup
recipes.summary: Freedom soup of pumpkin, beef and vegetables eaten on New Year's Day.
steps: Simmer the beef in the water with the onion, garlic, thyme and cloves for 40 minutes, until tender.
Add the pumpkin, potato, carrot and celery and simmer for 15 minutes, until all are soft.
Lift out about half the pumpkin and mash or blend it smooth, then return it to thicken the soup.
Add the cabbage and rigatoni and simmer for 10 minutes, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the parsley and lime juice, season and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: simmer the beef until tender and steaming hot throughout, at least 75°C in the centre of the pieces.

recipes.title: Puerto Rican Sofrito
recipes.summary: Fresh green herb and capsicum base used to start rice, beans and braises.
steps: Pulse the capsicum, onion, garlic and spring onion in a food processor until finely chopped but not a puree.
Add the coriander, parsley, oil, vinegar and salt and pulse until a coarse green paste forms.
Spoon into a jar or ice cube trays, and freeze in tablespoon portions.
notes: Freezes for up to 3 months in portions.

recipes.title: Dominican Mangú Mashed Plantain Breakfast
recipes.summary: Boiled green plantain mashed with butter and topped with quick pickled onion and fried eggs.

items: 4 green plantains, peeled and cut in chunks

steps: Boil the plantain in salted water for 20 minutes, until a knife slides in easily, saving a cup of the water.
Soak the onion in the vinegar with a pinch of salt for 15 minutes while the plantain cooks.
Mash the plantain with the butter and a splash of the cooking water to a smooth, thick puree.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Pile the mangú on plates and top with the pickled onion and eggs.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set, and the yolks too for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Bajan Macaroni Pie
recipes.summary: Baked macaroni in a cheesy custard with mustard, a fixture of the Sunday lunch table.
steps: Boil the macaroni in salted water for 8 minutes, until just tender, then drain and toss with the butter.
Soften the onion in a little water for 4 minutes, until translucent.
Whisk the eggs with the evaporated milk, mustard, tomato sauce, pepper and most of the cheese.
Fold the pasta and onion through the custard and tip into a baking dish, then top with the remaining cheese.
Bake at 180°C for 30 minutes, until set in the centre and golden on top.
notes: Food safety: bake until the custard is fully set, as it contains raw egg.

recipes.title: Nigerian Moi Moi Steamed Bean Pudding
recipes.summary: Soft steamed pudding of black-eyed beans with capsicum, onion and chilli, often with a boiled egg inside.

items: 300g dried black-eyed beans, soaked overnight and skinned

steps: Blend the beans with the capsicum, onion and chilli, adding the water, until completely smooth.
Stir in the oil, salt and crumbled stock cube, then fold the sliced eggs through gently.
Pour into 6 ramekins or foil cups, cover each tightly with foil.
Steam over simmering water for 40 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean and the tops are firm.
Rest for 5 minutes before turning out.
notes: Food safety: use hard-boiled eggs with firm yolks, and eat within a day or reheat until steaming hot.

recipes.title: Nigerian Efo Riro Spinach Stew
recipes.summary: Rich spinach stew in a pepper and tomato base with chicken and chilli, finished with a little stock.

items: 400g chicken thigh fillet, cut in chunks

steps: Blend the capsicums, tomatoes, half the onion and chillies to a smooth sauce, then boil it for 15 minutes until reduced and thick.
Simmer the chicken in the stock for 15 minutes, until cooked through and no pink remains.
Fry the remaining onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the reduced sauce and cook 10 minutes, until the oil rises to the surface.
Add the chicken with a little stock and the spinach and cook 5 minutes, until the leaves are soft but still green.
Season with the salt and serve with rice or boiled yam.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the thickest part and the juices run clear.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Waakye Rice and Beans
recipes.summary: Rice and beans cooked together until russet, served with fried eggs, spaghetti and a spicy sauce.
steps: Boil the beans in the water with the soda and onion for 30 minutes, until just tender and the water turns reddish.
Stir in the rice and salt and cook, covered, for 20 minutes until the rice is tender and the water absorbed.
Blend the passata, chillies and garlic and simmer 8 minutes, until thickened into a sauce.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Serve the waakye with the sauce and an egg on each plate.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set, and the yolks too for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Senegalese Salade Avocat Avocado and Prawn Salad
recipes.summary: Creamy avocado, tomato, cucumber and prawns in a mustard vinaigrette.
steps: Whisk the lime juice, oil, mustard, salt and pepper into a smooth vinaigrette.
Gently toss the avocado, prawns, tomato, cucumber and onion with the dressing until just coated.
Scatter with parsley and serve right away.
notes: Food safety: use prawns that are cooked and kept refrigerated, and eat the salad within a few hours.

recipes.title: Persian Ash Reshteh Herb Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: Thick soup of beans, lentils, herbs and noodles topped with fried onion, mint oil and yoghurt.
steps: Fry the onions in 2 tbsp oil for 20 minutes, stirring often, until deep golden and crisp, and set a third aside for the topping.
Add the turmeric, lentils and water to the rest of the onions and simmer for 20 minutes, until the lentils are soft.
Add the chickpeas, kidney beans, spinach and herbs, boil hard for 10 minutes then simmer 5 minutes more, until the greens are cooked down.
Add the linguine and simmer for 8 minutes, until the noodles are tender, then season well.
Warm the mint in the remaining oil for 1 minute and serve over the soup with the reserved onion and yoghurt.
notes: Add a splash of hot water if the soup thickens too much on standing.

recipes.title: Persian Mast-o-Khiar Yoghurt and Cucumber
recipes.summary: Cooling yoghurt with cucumber, mint and walnuts, eaten as a salad or dip.
steps: Stir the yoghurt, garlic, most of the mint, salt and pepper until smooth.
Fold through the cucumber and sultanas, then chill for 20 minutes.
Serve topped with the walnuts and a pinch of mint.
notes: Best the day it is made, as the cucumber releases water.

recipes.title: Persian Salad Shirazi
recipes.summary: Finely diced cucumber, tomato and onion with lime and dried mint.
steps: Dice the cucumber, tomato and onion to the same small size, around 5mm, until they are like a fine relish.
Toss with the lime juice, olive oil, mint, salt and pepper.
Rest 5 minutes, then taste and adjust the lime and salt.
notes: Dress just before serving so the vegetables stay crisp.

recipes.title: Persian Halim Chicken and Barley Porridge
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked porridge of shredded chicken and barley, topped with cinnamon sugar and melted butter.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the onion, turmeric and half the water for 25 minutes, until cooked through and tender, then shred the meat.
Simmer the barley in the remaining water for 90 minutes, stirring now and then, until completely soft and thick.
Add the shredded chicken and cook 40 minutes more, beating with a wooden spoon until the porridge is smooth and stretchy.
Season with the salt and pepper and divide among bowls.
Top with melted butter and a dusting of cinnamon and sugar.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the centre before shredding.
Add water if the porridge becomes too stiff while cooking.

recipes.title: Persian Mirza Ghasemi Smoky Aubergine and Egg
recipes.summary: Charred aubergine mashed with garlic, tomato and egg, a breakfast from northern Iran.
steps: Char the whole aubergines over a flame or under a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning, until blackened and collapsed.
Peel off the skin and mash the flesh roughly.
Fry the garlic and turmeric in the oil for 1 minute, then add the tomato and cook 6 minutes, until it breaks down.
Stir in the aubergine and cook 5 minutes, until thick and the oil separates.
Make three wells, crack in the eggs and stir until the eggs are fully set, about 3 minutes, then season.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm and fully set.

recipes.title: Israeli Sabich Aubergine and Egg Pita
recipes.summary: Fried aubergine, hard-boiled egg, salad and tahini in warm pita, a breakfast sandwich from Tel Aviv.
steps: Brush the aubergine with oil and roast at 220°C for 25 minutes, turning once, until deep golden and soft.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until the yolks are firm, then cool, peel and slice.
Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice, garlic, salt and enough water to make a pourable sauce.
Warm the pita until soft and pliable, about 1 minute.
Fill with aubergine, egg, tomato, cucumber and pickles, then drizzle with tahini and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are firm, and eat the sandwich the same day.

recipes.title: Peruvian Salsa Criolla Onion Relish
recipes.summary: Sharp, crisp red onion relish with lime and chilli for grilled meat, fish and sandwiches.
steps: Soak the sliced onion in cold salted water for 10 minutes, until the sharp edge has softened, then drain well.
Toss the onion with the lime, chilli, coriander, tomato, oil and salt.
Rest 5 minutes and serve.
notes: Make just before serving; it softens after an hour.

recipes.title: Peruvian Chupe de Camarones Prawn Chowder
recipes.summary: Rich prawn and corn chowder with potato, rice, egg and a little cheese, from Arequipa.
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil for 8 minutes, until golden, then stir in the tomato paste and paprika for 2 minutes.
Add the stock, potato, rice and corn and simmer for 20 minutes, until the rice and potato are tender.
Add the peas and evaporated milk and simmer 5 minutes, until hot and slightly thickened.
Add the prawns and cook 3 minutes, until pink and curled.
Poach the eggs in the soup for 3 minutes, until the whites are set, then top with ricotta and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the prawns until pink and opaque and the eggs until the whites are set.

recipes.title: Colombian Changua Milk and Egg Soup
recipes.summary: Bogotá's gentle breakfast soup of milk, spring onion and a poached egg with torn bread.
steps: Bring the milk, water and spring onion to a gentle simmer for 5 minutes, until the onion is soft and the milk steaming.
Season with salt and pepper, then crack in the eggs and poach for 3 minutes, until the whites are just set.
Ladle into bowls over the torn bread and sprinkle with coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set, and the yolks too for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Venezuelan Perico Scrambled Eggs
recipes.summary: Eggs scrambled with tomato, onion and capsicum, eaten with arepas or toast.
steps: Soften the onion and capsicum in the oil for 3 minutes, until translucent.
Add the tomato and cook 2 minutes, until it just starts to soften.
Pour in the beaten eggs and stir gently for 3 minutes until just set, then season and add spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set with no runny egg left.

recipes.title: Brazilian Farofa Toasted Cassava Flour
recipes.summary: Buttery toasted flour with onion and bacon, scattered over rice, beans and grilled meat.
steps: Fry the bacon in the butter for 5 minutes, until crisp, then add the onion for 3 minutes, until soft.
Push to one side, scramble in the eggs and cook 2 minutes, until just set.
Add the flour and stir for 3 minutes, until golden and toasty, then fold through the parsley.
Season to taste with salt and pepper, then serve warm.
notes: Food safety: cook the bacon until crisp and the eggs until set with no runny egg.

recipes.title: Chilean Pebre Fresh Salsa
recipes.summary: Fresh tomato, onion, coriander and chilli salsa with vinegar, served with bread and grilled meat.
steps: Soak the onion in cold water for 5 minutes, until the sharpness mellows, then drain well.
Mix with the tomato, coriander, chilli and garlic.
Stir in the vinegar, oil and salt and rest 10 minutes before serving.
notes: Best eaten the day it is made.
